Built from heavy-duty, USA-made polymer, these stationary blockers deliver a tight friction fit that holds in place without straps, bungees, or drilling. Pair them with adjustable blockers to build full dividers, or stack them with our Tmat accessories for a fully modular cargo organization system.

Why truck owners, contractors, and overlanders run Tmat blockers:

  • Snap-in install. No tools, no drilling, no permanent modifications to your truck bed
  • Tight-fit design holds gear in place under real-world driving conditions
  • USA-made, engineered by a team with 100+ years of combined experience
  • Backed by Tmat's Lifetime Warranty and 1,000+ five-star reviews
  • Compatible with every Tmat truck bed system we make

From the work site to the trailhead, Tmat takes your truck bed from chaos to control. Stop the slide. Stop the rattle. Start carrying gear the way it should be carried.

Built in the USA from heavy-duty polymer, the bucket holder is engineered to handle full loads of paint, parts, drywall mud, fishing tackle, or whatever your trade throws at it. No straps. No bungees. No spilled buckets across your bed liner.
